“Process restocking” prioritizes filling Lakeside City's iron shortfall up to a reserve of 600, with a maximum of 240 iron per trip. The departure depot targets 300 iron in stock, with 60 held in reserve, and prioritizes assigning certified technical workers to fill smelting shifts, reducing toolmaking positions accordingly (still subject to worker qualifications, furnace capacity, and local support constraints). Trade continues to exchange goods of equal value based on each side's actual shortfall; it does not create vehicles, inventory, or operating capacity. Revising the agreement costs each city 12 knowledge. If Lakeside switches back to another production policy, no new restocking orders will be sent; orders already in transit will still be settled as usual.

Once all construction materials arrive, the local settlement assigns 2 available workers to build for 600 seconds. Local support and the school must be prioritized during construction. Delivered materials go directly into the project ledger and are not returned even if the accompanying trade does not go through.
